finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Out of 380 commits, 14 matter to users.

Three are breaking and none were labeled that way. Dropped error-type re-exports, `403` to `401` on expired tokens, and a deleted v1 export route. All three landed as `refactor` or `fix`.

Two things to check before you cut. `docs: note the minimum node version` touched only docs, so I did not claim an engines bump. Nine `perf` commits exist but your three headings have no home for them.
